title: Coinbase says about 40% of its daily code is AI-generated, with mandatory review
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said on X that about 40% of the code written daily at Coinbase is AI-generated, set a target of over 50% by October, and added that the code needs to be reviewed and understood and that not all areas of the business can use AI-generated code. The Block reports that Coinbase tracks adoption through DORA metrics and AI-specific signals, manages the higher bug risk with a repository sensitivity matrix built with its security and privacy teams, and that Armstrong said some engineers who did not onboard to the AI coding tools within a week were fired.
verification_note: URL fetched on 2026-10-17; byline date September 4, 2025 confirmed from the article and its JSON-LD metadata. The 40% figure, the over-50% target, the review requirement, the scope exclusion, the repository sensitivity matrix and the dismissal of engineers who did not onboard are all stated in the article body; the claims originate from Armstrong's own X post and podcast remarks as quoted by The Block.
